snippet.title: Vixen gameplay (PC Game, 1988)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Vixen, Dos PC game produced by Martech in 1988 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/vixen/15762/
Vixen is a nice action game in which you fight with dinosaurs.. Each level must be completed within a time limit, but progressing from left to right.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.

Similar videos you may like:
Targhan - https://youtu.be/_PwopIIMCWU
Oliver & Company - https://youtu.be/QuFAk3j1kTY
